Ava was six. Every morning her hair was pulled back smooth and perfect. Then came the little red bumps. Then her temples started thinning. Then she stopped wanting to go swimming. 💔

That ponytail was meant to make her feel beautiful. Instead it made her feel worried about how she looked. A child's scalp is more delicate than ours, and pulling from one spot every day adds up.

Try the 2-finger test 🤞 If two fingers don't fit easily under the hair tie, it's too tight. So let her wear it loose, soft and comfortable.

"But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore." Luke 12:7

Her worth was never in her hairstyle, or in what others think. ❤️
